scope: Instructions only; no database modification or deletion performed by storage-audit agent.
before_application: Create consistent SQLite backup via sqlite3.Connection.backup(), verify PRAGMA integrity_check equals ok. Do not copy WAL database file alone.
Recheck every candidate hash/size and real path, all owners terminal, protected-path exclusions, and exact artifact row identity/status against audit. Never touch current run/model/analysis.
Sort registered candidates by artifact_id when using _assert_registry_plan_current and verify_retention_result.
Preserve all original artifact rows, checksum/size/path, checkpoint roles and retention metadata, runs/statuses, metrics, configs and completion markers.

pending_transaction.per_artifact: UPDATE artifacts SET status = ? WHERE artifact_id = ? AND status = ?
pending_transaction.per_checkpoint_or_optional_catalog_row: UPDATE checkpoint_catalog SET verification_status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE artifact_id = ?

file_operation: Unlink only audit file paths after rechecking all identities. Do not recursively delete broad directories or follow symlinks. Record each completed deletion. Retain enough inventory to recover interrupted pending state.

deleted_transaction.precondition: Every corresponding exact payload path absent and not symlink.
deleted_transaction.per_artifact: UPDATE artifacts SET status = ? WHERE artifact_id = ? AND status = ?
deleted_transaction.per_checkpoint_or_optional_catalog_row: UPDATE checkpoint_catalog SET verification_status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE artifact_id = ?

after_application: Recheck every intended deletion absent, all 32 registered artifact statuses deleted_by_retention, and all 30 checkpoint catalog statuses deleted_by_retention. No pending statuses should remain.
Record audit hash, registry backup path, exact deleted counts/bytes and before/after disk availability in application_receipt.json with sha256.
Confirm current training still running and protected reports/current best/latest checkpoints still present.
helper_limitations: Top-level compact_registered_artifacts/retire_registered_run_bundles call assert_no_live_experiments globally and will refuse while current training is running. Do not stop training to satisfy this. A scoped application must independently establish no selected path belongs to active writer.

verify_candidates assumes each selected file lies inside artifacts/runs/<run_id>. The two registered report files are outside run roots, so use exact audit identity checks for them instead. Scoped _mark_pending/_mark_deleted themselves operate by exact artifact IDs.
